description: Offline-only prerequisite inspection and closed-schema candidate-row validation for ACS 5-year Census ZCTA demographics; acquisition, durable admission, publication, pointers, and production enrollment are disabled.
redirect_policy: No network transport exists. URLs, hosts, redirects, acquisition, and download are outside this validator.
retry: No retry or acquisition path exists. Invalid or incomplete candidate rows fail closed and remain unadmitted.
checkpoint: No checkpoint or durable receipt is created. Descriptor-bound reads produce one nonpersistent inspection result; candidate-row validation is in-memory only.
idempotency: Pinned prerequisite SHA-256 values and exact governed ZCTA replay yield the same inspection; identical candidate rows yield the same validation decision. No state is written.
cancellation: The surrounding prerequisite inspection accepts AbortSignal and creates no output. Candidate-row validation is synchronous, bounded to one row, and writes nothing.
retention_profile: The validator retains nothing. Future retained ACS inputs require exact metadata and authorization receipts plus a separately reviewed immutable publication lifecycle.
